in_sanskrit.name: विश्वास
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Bishan' in Sanskrit is derived from the word 'Vishvas', which means 'contentment', 'faith', or 'trust'. It is a name that signifies happiness, prosperity, and a positive outlook on life.

in_hindi.name: विश्वास
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Bishan' in Hindi translates to 'Santushht', which means 'content' or 'satisfied', and 'Sukhī', which means 'happy'. It is a name that evokes feelings of joy, happiness, and prosperity.

in_tamil.name: விஷ்வாச
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name 'Bishan' in Tamil translates to 'Vishvas', which means 'desire', 'longing', 'joy', 'happiness', 'prosperity', and 'contentment'. It is a name that embodies the qualities of a content and happy person.

in_telugu.name: విశ్వాశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name 'Bishan' in Telugu translates to 'Vishvas', which means 'one who is peaceful and contented', and 'Shubhamukhe', which means 'one who has a good and happy face'. It is a name that signifies contentment, happiness, and prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Bishan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bishan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bishan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vishnu’, meaning 'abode of all'. It is a name bestowed upon those who are believed to be blessed and fortunate. This name carries the blessings of Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe and the embodiment of love, compassion, and wisdom.
